rachel: Quick Q 1
We need a concise acceptance rubric for pilot launches that include cross-region fallback. Customers want to know exactly what we validate before enabling it. Can @omar or @jin draft an acceptance rubric?

omar: I'll draft. Key headings: Preconditions, Validation tests, Observability checks, and Emergency rollback. Keep customer-facing language.

jin: Add a required cost simulation step that estimates per-1M tokens delta when spillover occurs. Also require an SLO burn-in test (48h) with synthetic traffic.

rachel: Draft below. Short, numbered list.

rachel: ```text
Pilot acceptance rubric - cross-region fallback
1) Preconditions: customer ADP & KMS configured, residency flags set, SLA tier chosen
2) Validation tests: (a) 1-hour smoke with pilot prompts; (b) 10-minute simulated cross-region spill at 5% traffic
3) Observability: p50/p90/p99, token cost service metric, kv-evac-time all live in dashboard
4) Safety checks: correctness regressions <5% vs baseline; no private-data leakage during spillover
5) Rollback criteria: any p99 spike >2x baseline OR correctness regression >5% => immediate disable of cross-region fallback
6) Postmortem: ops + product + legal required within 72h for any triggered rollback
```

ops-bot: Scheduled runbook: runway-test-01 set for 2024-03-20 02:00Z

sales_ops: We'll prep the customer comms template. Flag for legal review on residency wording.

rachel: Thanks. I'll fold into the pilot onboarding doc and share the short version with AMs. :ok_hand:
